rules.title: 幾何拓撲防錯位規範 (Anti-Topology Swapping)
rules.rule: 若該頁原圖為「橫向 4 欄流程卡片」，提示詞必須強制約束『🚫 嚴禁退化為 2x2 矩陣』；若原圖為「2x2 四象限矩陣」，『🚫 嚴禁退化為水平時間軸』；若原圖為「連續 Chevron 流程箭頭」，『🚫 嚴禁退化為普通方塊』！每一頁的視覺拓撲必須剛性鎖定！

rules.title: 幾何組件實心飽滿填色 (Solid Color Fill, No Wireframes)
rules.rule: 所有箭頭、卡片與圖示徽章必須使用飽滿的實心色彩填充（Solid Color Fill），『🚫 絕對嚴禁生成黑色單線條無填色外框（Hollow Wireframe / Empty Outlines）』，確保畫面具備足夠的視覺量感與衝擊力！

rules.title: 步驟數量 1:1 剛性守恆 (Step-Count Integrity)
rules.rule: 原圖有幾個步驟（例如 4 步或 5 步），生成內容必須剛性產出相同數量的欄位或節點，『🚫 絕對嚴禁擅自合併或縮減步驟數量』！

rules.title: 圖表色彩純度防雜色污染 (Chart Palette Purity & Anti-Color Contamination)
rules.rule: 圓餅圖、長條圖與區域圖之數據組件，必須嚴格限定使用該風格指定之純色扁平填色；『🚫 嚴禁自動衍生非預期的泥褐色、濁黃色、中灰色等雜色扇形或長條』，維持色彩系統之純度！

rules.title: 插畫線條與形狀保真 (Vector Stroke & Graphic Fidelity)
rules.rule: 原圖若為向量線條插畫（如階梯、引線、軸線），必須維持簡潔之扁平向量線條；『🚫 嚴禁畸變為笨重之 3D 塊狀物或實心色塊堆疊』！

rules.title: Color Lock Constraint
rules.rule: Strictly limit palette to exact 3 colors: Crimson Red (#FF0033), Pure Black (#000000), and Off-White background (#F5F5F0). NO brown, NO yellow, NO grey, NO gradients. Force 100% flat vector flat colors.

rules.title: Visual Element Guardrail
rules.rule: Do NOT render 3D blocks or mud-colored shapes. If stairs/graphs are requested, render them using clean stroke lines or solid red/black flat vector shapes only.

rules.title: Chart Color Consistency
rules.rule: All pie slices and bar charts MUST strictly use solid Crimson Red or Pure Black. Prohibit automatically generating tertiary color fills (like beige, grey, brown) in chart elements.

rules.title: Layout Consistency
rules.rule: Maintain top-right red dot matrix grid (5x5) and exact vertical thick red accent border on the slide edges (left edge for slide 1, right edge for slide 3).

rules.title: 幾何架構鎖定
rules.rule: Strict Grid Enforcement: Maintain exact layout topology; do not replace a 2x3 grid with radial/arc timelines or vice versa.

rules.title: 渲染防空保底
rules.rule: Anti-Blank Canvas: Ensure all nodes, text fields, and visual anchors are fully populated; no empty slides or omitted containers.

rules.title: 色彩數量強約束
rules.rule: Color Cardinality: Exactly match the N-step dynamic color mapping per node; prohibit collapsing multi-color sequences into a single accent color.

rules.title: FORBIDDEN DIAGRAM CONVERSION
rules.rule: DO NOT convert horizontal timelines into circular or donut charts. DO NOT alter the node count (e.g., if input has 5 or 6 steps, keep EXACTLY 5 or 6 steps, do not decrease or merge).

rules.title: GEOMETRY & STRUCTURE LOCK
rules.rule: Slide 1 MUST BE: A strict 5-column horizontal process flow along a single horizontal baseline. Slide 2 MUST BE: A split layout with a 5-segment graphic on the LEFT and vertical text blocks on the RIGHT. Slide 3 MUST BE: A 6-step serpentine/alternating wave layout (3 steps top, 3 steps bottom).

rules.title: CONTENT DEDUPLICATION RULE
rules.rule: STRICTLY PROHIBITED: Repeating text, titles, or descriptions across different nodes. Every node must contain unique, non-repetitive text.

rules.title: VISUAL ANCHOR MANDATE
rules.rule: MUST retain icon containers (circles/hexagons) inside or attached to each step card as visual anchors.

rules.title: ZERO METADATA LEAKAGE
rules.rule: NEVER output prompt instructions or visual guidelines (e.g., "嚴格五色階梯", "海軍藍基底") as slide body text. Content must strict adhere to business topics.

rules.title: GEOMETRIC STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY
rules.rule: If the layout is a sequential process/staircase (e.g., 6 steps), strictly generate a STAIRCASE/TIMELINE diagram with EXACTLY 6 nodes. Do NOT convert to puzzle pieces or change the node count. For connected diagrams: Preserve explicit visual connectors (pointer lines/arrows) between header cards and central concentric circles. Do NOT break into disconnected left/right split columns.

rules.title: FALLBACK & RENDER PROTECTION
rules.rule: Ensure complete DOM/Canvas rendering on every page. Empty white frames are strictly forbidden; apply standard 2-column fallback layouts if complex 3D graphic rendering fails.

rules.title: 禁止省略或簡化任何視覺化元素
rules.rule: 嚴格要求 NotebookLM 不得省略、簡化或替換原始簡報中的任何圖表類型（如折線圖、甜甜圈圖）、進度條、圖示及數據標籤。所有視覺元素必須完整且精確地呈現，不得僅以文字描述取代。

rules.title: 禁止替換或修改數據與文字內容
rules.rule: 必須忠實還原原始簡報中的所有數值數據、百分比、狀態描述（如 "on target", "Pending"）及表格內容。嚴禁使用佔位符號（如 "--"）或自行生成不符的內容，確保資訊的精確性與完整性。

rules.title: 嚴格維持版型幾何結構與空間佈局
rules.rule: 必須精確複製原始簡報的卡片佈局、元素相對位置、間距與視覺層次感。禁止任何導致元素擠壓、錯位或破壞整體空間節奏感的變動，確保幾何結構與視覺空間感完全一致。

rules.title: 禁止更改投影片標題與副標題
rules.rule: 投影片的主標題與副標題必須精確翻譯或直接引用原始簡報內容，嚴禁自行修改、縮減或生成任何不符的標題，以確保內容的一致性。
